title: Normalize-Then-Precondition: A Hierarchical Approach to Marginal Scale and Interaction Geometry for LLM Training
abstract: arXiv:2609.36692v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Matrix optimizers have emerged as a promising direction, with Muon standing out as a prominent design. Revisiting Muon through its full-Gram representation, we observe that it jointly processes marginal-scale and interaction information. This opens an alternative way to organize geometric information hierarchically, motivating the Normalize-Then-Precondition framework. Specifically, it first uses diagonal-Gram information to construct a marginally normalized update, then applies spectral preconditioning to its directional interaction geometry. Building on this framework, we develop NormPre with NormPre-G and NormPre-L adopting global and localized spectral preconditioning, grounded in spectral-norm steepest descent and a regularized formulation followed by leading mode selection, respectively. translated_title: 先归一化后预条件化：一种面向大语言模型训练的边际尺度与交互几何分层处理方法
translated_abstract: 矩阵优化器已成为一个有前景的研究方向，其中Muon是杰出的设计。我们通过完整的Gram表示重新审视Muon，观察到它同时处理了边际尺度信息和交互信息。这为分层组织几何信息开辟了一种新的途径，由此催生了“先归一化后预条件化”框架。具体而言，该框架首先利用对角Gram信息构建边际归一化的更新，然后对其方向性交互几何施加谱预条件化。基于该框架，我们开发了NormPre系列优化器，其中NormPre-G采用全局谱预条件化，NormPre-L采用局部化谱预条件化，二者分别建立在谱范数最速下降以及正则化形式加主导模态选择的理论基础上。为支持大规模训练，NormPre-G使用Newton-Schulz迭代，NormPre-L采用随机草图方法来近似主导成分。
tldr: 提出“先归一化后预条件化”分层优化框架及NormPre系列优化器，将边际尺度归一化与谱预条件化解耦，为LLM大规模训练提供了高效的矩阵优化新方案。
en_tdlr: Proposes the Normalize-Then-Precondition framework and NormPre optimizers that hierarchically decouple marginal-scale normalization from spectral preconditioning of interaction geometry, enabling efficient matrix-based optimization for large-scale LLM training.
